# Mirai — AI Automation Agency

> Mirai builds and deploys AI voice agents, workflow automation systems, custom AI chatbots, and AI lead generation for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia. Most projects go live within 1 week.

## What We Do

Mirai is an AI automation agency that helps non-technical business owners eliminate operational bottlenecks and scale their capacity without scaling headcount. We build production-ready AI systems — not strategy decks or pilot programs.

**Target clients:** Law firms, real estate agencies, dental and medical clinics, e-commerce brands, home services companies, and B2B service businesses with 5–200 employees.

**Target markets:** US, UK, Canada, Australia (English-speaking Western SMBs).

## Services

### AI Voice Agents
We build AI-powered phone agents that handle inbound and outbound calls 24/7. They qualify leads, book appointments, answer FAQs, take messages, and escalate to humans when needed. Built with natural multi-turn conversation — not IVR menus.
- Starts at $8,000 setup + $500/month
- Deployed in under 1 week
- Integrates with Cal.com, Calendly, GoHighLevel, and most CRMs
- URL: https://themiraitech.com/services#voice-agents

### Workflow Automation
We design and build end-to-end automation workflows using n8n, Make (Integromat), and custom APIs. We connect tools into a single intelligent system that eliminates manual, repetitive work.
- Starts at $3,000 for a single workflow system
- 80+ native integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Slack, Google Workspace, etc.)
- URL: https://themiraitech.com/services#workflow-automation

### AI Chatbots & RAG Systems
Custom AI chatbots powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) — trained on your documents, products, and policies. Deployable on websites, WhatsApp, Slack, or internal tools.
- Starts at $4,000 setup + $300/month
- Deflects up to 80% of support tickets automatically
- URL: https://themiraitech.com/services#chatbots

### AI Lead Generation
AI-powered outreach and lead nurturing systems that identify, contact, qualify, and warm prospects — delivering ready-to-close leads without manual effort.
- Starts at $5,000 setup + $800/month
- Multi-channel: email, LinkedIn, SMS
- Compliance-first (CAN-SPAM, GDPR)
- URL: https://themiraitech.com/services#lead-generation

## Common Questions

**Q: How long does AI automation take to deploy?**
A: Most projects go live in 3–5 days. Simple automations can be ready in 24–48 hours. Complex integrations take up to 1 week.

**Q: Does AI automation work for small businesses?**
A: Yes. Mirai specifically serves SMBs with 5–200 employees. The best candidates have repetitive high-volume tasks, a clear bottleneck, and a desire to scale without adding staff.

**Q: What industries does Mirai serve?**
A: Law firms, real estate agencies, dental and medical clinics, e-commerce brands, home services companies, and any SMB with high call volume or repetitive admin tasks.

**Q: What countries does Mirai operate in?**
A: Mirai serves businesses in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia.
